extension.summary: Mirror playback from this Kodi box to a second Kodi box
extension.description:
Leader/follower synchronised playback for two Kodi installs sharing the same Jellyfin server. The leader forwards play, pause, seek and stop to the follower over Kodi's JSON-RPC API, so the same item plays on both screens at the same position.
Install on both boxes. Set one to Leader and point it at the other's IP. Set the other to Follower. The follower needs Settings > Services > Control > "Allow remote control via HTTP" and "Allow remote control from applications on other systems" enabled.
extension.news: 2.1.0: Sync Group: 10 named device slots, pause/resume from any device echoes to all, stopping pauses everyone else and says which device left, and a device coming online mid-film joins where the others are. 2.0.0: Peer mode: any number of boxes, whichever one starts a film drives the rest, and pause/resume/seek from ANY box mirrors to all. Leader/Follower mode unchanged. 1.2.0: "When this box stops" option: stop the follower, pause it (stop in one room, press play in the other to carry on), or leave it playing. 1.1.0: New option "Stop follower on stop/exit": turn it off and stopping or exiting the leader leaves the follower playing; play/pause/seek still mirror. 1.0.2: Settings dialog: shorter labels that fit the list, full explanations shown as help text, proper strings.po. 1.0.1: Reliability fixes: explicit play/pause instead of toggling, follower no longer left playing if the leader stops mid-handshake, resume no longer drags the follower behind, faster shutdown response.
